title: Spring Egg Rolls with Russian Sour Cream
description: A delicious twist on traditional spring rolls, served with a tangy Russian sour cream sauce.
instructions: 1. Preheat a deep frying pan or a deep fryer to 350°F (175°C).
2. Remove the spring rolls from the package and separate them. If frozen, thaw according to package instructions.
3. In a small bowl, beat the eggs.
4. Dip each spring roll into the beaten eggs, coating completely.
5. Fry the spring rolls in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
6. Remove the fried spring rolls from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. In a separate bowl, mix together the Russian dressing and sour cream.
8. Place the fried spring rolls on a serving platter and drizzle with the Russian sour cream sauce.
9. Sprinkle chopped Russian dill on top for garnish.
